meta.name: LOL! Network
meta.description:
Kevin Hart presents nonstop fearless comedy with an all-star roster, as LOL! Network tackles celebrity, sports, culture, and the ridiculousness of modern life with unmissable exclusive original series, and the best series, movies, and stand-up.

Shows: So Dumb It's Criminal, Real Husbands of Hollywood, National Lampoon's Dirty Movie, Van Wilder: Party Liaison, The Black Lot
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
